name: Karina O'Connor
source:
Karina is one of Ben's old friends from elementary school who by chance happens to be attending the same university as him after not seeing each other for years. Their friendship continues almost as if it never ended.

[Based on [url=https://stormsingerstudios.itch.io/santa-lucia]itch.io[/url]]
